 Launch of the Global Call on Obesity
 Launch of the Global Call on Obesity
 18 November 2026 16:30 – 17:30 UTC Time 
 Reading time: 
 Believe it’s time to act on obesity? Join us. 
 More than one billion people worldwide live with obesity, including about 160 million children and adolescents, and the numbers are rising in every region. But momentum is building, and this is your chance to be part of it.
 Join government leaders, global health experts, people living with obesity and partners from around the world as we launch the Global Call to Action on Obesity . It is a shared commitment to speed up action to prevent and manage obesity by 2030.
 Why join? 
 Celebrate what we’ve achieved together. Hear the highlights of the Global Obesity Summit in Madrid and the progress countries are making under the WHO Acceleration Plan to Stop Obesity.
 Be there for the launch. Find out what the Global Call to Action asks of governments, partners and communities.
 Turn commitment into change. Learn how you can put the Call to Action into practice in your country, organization or community.
 Building on Madrid 
From 26 to 28 October, the Global Obesity Summit in Madrid brought together frontrunner countries, UN agencies, civil society, people living with obesity, youth, academia and partners. They took stock of progress, shared lessons and set priorities for the road to 2030. The Summit was hosted by Spain’s Ministry of Health and Ministry of Social Affairs, WHO, UNICEF and the World Bank. This webinar carries that momentum forward.
 Who should attend? 
Everyone ready to move from commitment to action: policy-makers, health professionals, civil society, researchers, youth advocates, people with lived experience and partners across sectors.
